# elasticstack_fleet_agent_policy (Data Source)

Returns a Fleet agent policy looked up by `policy_id` or `name`. See https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/fleet/current/agent-policy.html

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Excluded from TestAccExamples_planOnly (planOnlySkippedEmbedPaths): agent policy
# and enrollment token reads require a Fleet agent policy that exists in Kibana/Fleet;
# example names and UUIDs vary by stack. Substitute name or policy_id from your Fleet
# agent policy before apply.

provider "elasticstack" {
  kibana {}
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_agent_policy" "pernode" {
  name     = "k8s-metrics-pernode"
  space_id = "default"
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_enrollment_tokens" "pernode" {
  policy_id = data.elasticstack_fleet_agent_policy.pernode.policy_id
}

data "elasticstack_fleet_agent_policy" "by_id" {
  policy_id = "223b1bf8-240f-463f-8466-5062670d0754"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kibana_connection` (Block List) Kibana connection configuration block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kibana_connection))
- `name` (String) The name of the agent policy. Set exactly one of `policy_id` or `name`; the other is populated from the API response.
- `policy_id` (String) The identifier of the agent policy. Set exactly one of `policy_id` or `name`; the other is populated from the API response.
- `space_id` (String) An identifier for the space. If space_id is not provided, the default space is used.

### Read-Only

- `advanced_monitoring_options` (Attributes) Advanced monitoring options for the agent policy, including the HTTP monitoring endpoint and diagnostic settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_monitoring_options))
- `advanced_settings` (Attributes) Advanced agent settings for logging, resource limits, and downloads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_settings))
- `data_output_id` (String) The identifier for the data output.
- `description` (String) The description of the agent policy, as returned by the Fleet API.
- `download_source_id` (String) The identifier for the Elastic Agent binary download server.
- `fleet_server_host_id` (String) The identifier for the Fleet server host.
- `global_data_tags` (Attributes Map) User-defined tags. Keyed by tag name; each entry has exactly one of `string_value` or `number_value`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_data_tags))
- `host_name_format` (String) Hostname format reported for agents in this policy. `hostname` is the short hostname; `fqdn` is the fully qualified domain name.
- `id` (String) The ID of this agent policy.
- `inactivity_timeout` (String) Time an agent can be inactive before it is marked inactive. A duration string such as `30s`, `2m`, or `1h`.
- `is_protected` (Boolean) Whether tamper protection is enabled for this agent policy (Fleet API `is_protected`).
- `monitor_logs` (Boolean) Whether collection of agent logs is enabled.
- `monitor_metrics` (Boolean) Whether collection of agent metrics is enabled.
- `monitoring_output_id` (String) The identifier for monitoring output.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the agent policy.
- `required_versions` (Map of Number) Map of agent versions to target percentages for automatic upgrade. The key is the target version and the value is the percentage of agents to upgrade to that version.
- `space_ids` (Set of String) The Kibana space IDs that this agent policy is available in.
- `supports_agentless` (Boolean) Whether the agent policy supports agentless data collection.
- `unenrollment_timeout` (String) Time an agent can be inactive before it is automatically unenrolled. A duration string such as `30s`, `2m`, or `1h`.

<a id="nestedblock--kibana_connection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kibana_connection`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key to use for authentication to Kibana
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer Token to use for authentication to Kibana
- `ca_certs` (List of String) A list of paths to CA certificates to validate the certificate presented by the Kibana server.
- `endpoints` (List of String, Sensitive) A comma-separated list of endpoints where the terraform provider will point to, this must include the http(s) schema and port number.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate validation
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to use for API authentication to Kibana.
- `username` (String) Username to use for API authentication to Kibana.
